title: Commercial Credit Account Payment Methods, Card Fees and Application of Payments
content:
Payments to a Commercial Credit Account are accepted by ACH credit, ACH debit, wire, check or commercial card.

### Card payments

1. A single commercial card payment may not exceed the tier's card payment maximum; a larger balance is paid by another method or in more than one card payment on different days.
2. Every card payment carries a card convenience fee of the tier's card fee percent of the amount charged, rounded to the cent, assessed as its own charge; ACH, wire and check payments carry no fee.

### Checks after a returned payment

3. A payment by check is accepted only when it is received no earlier than the tier's certified-funds period in calendar months after the date of the most recent returned payment on the account.
4. Add the months to the date of the most recent returned payment by calendar month; when the target month has no such day the boundary is the last day of that month, and a check received on the boundary date is accepted.

### Application

5. A payment with remittance detail is applied to the invoices the remittance names; a payment without remittance detail is held unapplied for the tier's unapplied-cash hold in business days and then applied by the tier's application order, oldest due date first and within one due date oldest invoice number first.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, 6-month period)

| Most recent returned payment | Boundary date | Check received on the boundary | Check received the day before |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 March | 10 September | accepted | not accepted |
| 31 August | 28 February (29 February in a leap year) | accepted | not accepted |

*Card fee, hypothetical:* a card payment of 4321.00 at 2.5 percent carries a fee of 108.03 (108.025 rounded to the cent).
